miny.definition: a. Abounding with mines; like a mine.

minyan.definition: n. the quorum required by Jewish law to be present for public worship (at least ten males over thirteen years of age)
minyan.translation:
n. (相传住在古希腊中部的)米尼安人 
n. (犹太教)举行正式礼拜仪式的法定人数(至少须有10名13岁以上的男子)

minyulite.translation: 水磷钾铝石; 水磷铝钾石
